decision: oceancube owns field-to-field transformation, physical and geometric fields, I/O, metadata, storage, and visualization; it does not own ecological indicators
rationale: Preserves a coherent upstream data-cube and physical-field role
source: post-release audit; inst/architecture/oceancube-spatind-boundary.md; maintainer roadmap contract
revisit_trigger: A proposed feature cannot be classified as field preparation, physical diagnosis, geometry, storage, or visualization

decision: spatind owns indicator construction, indicator time series, uncertainty, trend inference, breakpoints, and regime interpretation
rationale: Separates downstream ecological/statistical meaning from upstream field transformations
source: post-release audit; maintainer roadmap contract
revisit_trigger: A versioned downstream contract demonstrates a necessary shared responsibility

decision: cube_trend remains a descriptive per-cell elapsed-time ordinary linear slope
rationale: The current tested contract is descriptive field transformation and contains no inference
source: current source, tests, man page, handbook, and maintainer roadmap contract

decision: Sen slopes, Mann-Kendall tests, p-values, breakpoints, and regime shifts are excluded from oceancube

decision: oceancube will not reimplement TEOS-10 equations and will delegate thermodynamic calculations to gsw

decision: oceancube prepares renderer-neutral scientific 3-D data and keeps the renderer replaceable
rationale: Scientific preparation, decimation, orientation, and provenance must not depend on one graphics package
source: user-driven requirement; ggcube, OceanView, and rgl review; maintainer roadmap contract

decision: hardening measurement infrastructure precedes CF, vertical, vector, and 3-D feature expansion
